commit_message: Add Native 2D Scene View camera mode
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
Adds orthographic XY Scene View camera input/rendering, an XY grid, planar gizmo hit testing, and an explicit 2D/3D toolbar switch through the existing runtime Camera2D preview path.
